facts.fact: Le Soleil reports that AI Hub Senegal, with the French embassy, presented on 2026-10-16 the Kiriku Voice challenge results: 210 hours of annotated Wolof, Pulaar and Serer speech data and two models, M-Kiriku ASR and M-Kiriku TTS, published openly on Hugging Face.
